notes.title: [Until the Portal opens again...]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]It's a wrap- the Playtest has officially come to an end! 
[/h2][/b]

[h3]As of 08:00 (UTC+0), the Playtest for World of the dead has officially concluded! We sincerely thank all our survivors who have been following us on this unforgettable journey!
[/h3]

The Playtest is over, but the journey of World of the dead is far from over. our team is thrilled to share that we will be introducing a new version of the game in the near future. As we plan to reveal more news regarding project periodically, we hope survivors will stay with us for more deadly updates to come. 

Since the response to the Playtest was beyond our wildest expectations, we are now hard at work, building upon the valuable feedback and insights every survivor provided during the Playtest to refine and enhance the project even further.

We invite you to stay with us on this journey by following our official Discord and social media channels. We will make sure to keep you posted on any progress we make through our official channels.

Farewell, survivors! Until the portal between hell and earth opens again..

notes.title: [Playtest Ends Tomorrow!]
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors. 

The end of the World of the dead Playtest is just a day away! A huge thanks to all survivors who have actively participated and provided insightful suggestions and feedback so far.

As previously noted, the playtest will conclude on November 4, 08:00 (UTC+0). With just one day left, we encourage all survivors to make the most of the remaining time by exploring the content available in game, and trying out the various weapon groups featured in the game.

Our team also welcomes all feedback and suggestions, as every survivor’s perspective is valuable to us. If you have any thoughts on how World of the dead can improve further, feel free to share them with us in the suggestions-feedback channel on our official Discord server. 

We hope you enjoy World of the dead to the fullest during this final day!

notes.title: [World of the dead CBT FAQ]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Hello Survivors!
[/h2][/b]

As we count down to the first day of the World of the dead CBT, here is everything all survivors need to know, along with answers to frequently asked questions for both new and returning survivors.

[b][h3]How to Join the CBT:
[/h3][/b]The CBT goes live on October 29 at 22:00 (UTC) / October 30 at 07:00 (KST). If you wish to join, please visit the official World of the dead Steam store page and click the "Request Access" button.


[b]CBT Schedule:
[/b][b]Start Date: October 29, 22:00 (UTC) / October 30, 07:00 (KST)
End Date: November 4, 08:00 (UTC) / November 4, 17:00 (KST)[/b]
The CBT will run for about five days only. Survivors eager to help shape the future of World of the dead are more than welcome to join! Stay tuned for more updates-- we will see you in the world of the dead!


[b]Q:[/b] Which platform is World of the dead available on?
[b]A:[/b] World of the dead is currently available exclusively on PC.


[b]Q: [/b]What are the recommended system requirements for World of the dead?
[b]A:[/b] The recommended system requirements for World of the dead are as follows;
[i]Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64-bit Windows 10
Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 40 GB available space[/i]


[b]Q: [/b]I submitted a playtest application through the official World of the dead Steam store page. Will I be notified if my playtest application is approved?
[b]A:[/b] If you are accepted as a playtester for the CBT, you will receive an email from Steam at the email address registered to your Steam account. Be sure to check your inbox regularly! 


[b]Q:[/b] Where can I report bugs?
[b]A: [/b]We have set up a Discord channel called #report-a-bug ([url=discord.com/channels/1282528908591239241/1295372522384265237]discord.com/channels/1282528908591239241/1295372522384265237[/url]) where survivors can describe any issues they come across in detail. Attaching screenshots or videos along with the description is encouraged to help us handle the issue promptly! Rest assured, your report won’t go unnoticed, as we are actively monitoring the channel.


[b]Q:[/b] Duo and Squad mode were unavailable in the last SNF. Will I be able to play with my friends this time?
[b]A:[/b] That is correct. Both Duo and Squad modes are expected to return in the upcoming CBT. It is too dangerous to go alone. bring your friends and fight back against the abhorrent hellspawns together!


[b]Q:[/b] How many language options will be available in the CBT?
[b]A:[/b] A total of 12 languages will be available in the CBT. The language options are as follows:
English, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Spanish (Mexico), Spanish (Spain), German, French, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), and Russian.


[b]Q: [/b]Will players have a chance to experience new maps?
[b]A:[/b] Absolutely. Two new maps- Wasteland and Issaquah- will be introduced in the upcoming CBT. 
Wasteland is an underground-themed map where an underground shelter has been overrun by demons and zombies. The other new map, Issaquah, is set in an abandoned village, with reanimated villagers and distorted beasts swarming from all directions.


[b]Q:[/b] I don’t think I have fully grasped the basics of gameplay and could use another tutorial session. Is there a way to replay the tutorial?
[b]A:[/b] To replay the tutorial, press ESC -> Settings, then go to the Gameplay tab and click the Retry Tutorial button.


[b]Q: [/b]The FAQ doesn't solve my questions. What should I do?
[b]A: [/b]If the FAQ does not answer your questions, feel free to ask other survivors in our official Discord server.
Our team is also working on a dedicated Customer Support website where survivors will be able to submit tickets for any gameplay issues. We will announce its launch through official channels once it’s ready. In the meantime, we will do our best to help resolve any gameplay issues through Discord.

notes.title: World of the dead의 Demo 일정이 후반으로 접어들었습니다!
notes.notes:
안녕하세요 생존자님! 

World of the dead의 Demo 일정이 후반으로 접어들었습니다. 망자들의 죄어오는 파멸의 손아귀로부터 세계를 해방시키기 위해, 공개 직후 지금까지 함깨해주신 수천명의 생존자 여러분들께 진심으로 감사의 인사를 전합니다. 

Demo 버전은 한국 시간 (KST) 10월 22일 02:00 기준으로 종료됩니다. 아직 플레이 하지 않으신 생존자 분들이 계시다면, 호러 익스트랙션 슈팅의 정수를 맛볼 수 있는 World of the dead로의 세계로 여러분들을 초대합니다.

언제나 감사드리며, 앞으로도 World of the dead에 더욱 많은 관심 부탁드립니다. 이번 Demo가 종료되기 이전까지 world of the dead 에서 생존자 여러분들의 참여를 기다리겠습니다!

notes.title: 비전 스튜디오에서 중요한 공지를 전달드립니다.
notes.notes:
[h3]안녕하세요, WOD 개발팀 비전 스튜디오입니다.
[/h3]

우선, 원더피플과 슈퍼피플을 아끼고 지지해주시고 계신 모든 분들께 깊은 감사를 전합니다. 여러분의 뜨거운 관심과 애정 덕분에 저희가 한 걸음 더 성장하고 있다는 것을 느낍니다.

많은 분들이 슈퍼피플에 대한 그리움과 열정을 가지고 계신다는 점을 잘 알고 있습니다. 이번 World of the Dead 공개 후 지속적으로 보여주시는 관심을 통해 그만큼 저희가 슈퍼피플을 서비스 종료하게 되었을 때 많은 실망과 아쉬움을 느끼신 점 매우 죄송스럽게 생각합니다.

사실 슈퍼피플은 총 개발 기간 6년, 총비용 약 800억 원,개발, 운영 인력이 합쳐서 약 200명에 달할 정도로 많은 시간과 자원이 투입된 대형 프로젝트였습니다. 그러나 의욕에 앞서 핵, 유료화 모델 실패 등 예상치 못한 여러 상황을 런칭 초반부터 겪으며 당시 슈퍼피플1의 매출로는 서버 유지비조차 감당이 되지 않았습니다. 회사는 직원들의 급여를 지급하는 데 어려움을 겪었습니다.

그래서 많은 분들이 회사를 떠났고 프로젝트에 애정이 너무 큰 5명의 소수 인원만이 남아 밸런스 패치를 계속하면서 힘겹게 개발과 서비스를 이어가기 위해 더 노력을 했었습니다.

결국 마지막에는 유저수가 줄어서 매칭이 제대로 되지 않은 수준까지 이르러 어쩔 수 없이 게임 서비스를 종료했습니다.

이런 상황에서도 저희는 슈퍼피플에 대한 미련을 버리지 못하고 새로운 모드를 추가해서 부활을 꿈꾸었습니다. 그 결과물이 지금 World of the Dead입니다.

다행히 프로토 타입이 내부 테스트 결과 재미가 있어서 꾸준히 개발자들이 다시 돌아오고 충원해서 현재 약 30여명 규모로 증가 했습니다.

쓸데없는 모드 만들지 말고 슈퍼피플1이나 다시 열어달라고 요청하시는 유저분들도 계시지만, 이미 슈퍼피플 런칭 당시 직원들 월급은 고사하고 서버비용도 안 되는 매출을 기록했기에 운영에 대한 두려움이 있었습니다.

World of the dead는 단순히 슈퍼피플의 IP와 리소스를 사용한 슈퍼피플과 다른 게임이 아닌, 슈퍼피플 세계관을 기반으로 한 짧지만 강렬한 재미를 선보일 스핀 오프 게임입니다. 

현실에서 슈퍼피플이 망한거처럼, World of the Dead는 게임내의 오브아일랜드에서 입자 가속기 실험을 하다가 차원의 문이 열려서 악마, 좀비, 야수 등 수많은 괴물들이 섬에 출현하여 세상이 멸망해버린 설정입니다.특수 능력을 잃어버린 소수의 생존자들이 자신을 성장시키고 강한 무기들을 모아 대마왕을 물리치고 세상을 부활 시키는것이 목표입니다.
망해버린 회사에 5명이 남아 슈퍼피플의 부활을 꿈꾸었던 마음을 설정에 담았습니다.

World of the dead의 성공을 위해 전 직원이 노력하고 있고, World of the dead와 함께 슈퍼피플1의 부활 알리고 플레이할 수 있는 기회를 제공하는 것을 핵심 목표로 삼고 있습니다.

[b]감히 말씀드리자면 내년 상반기에 슈퍼피플1을 재런칭할 수 있도록 다양한 방면으로 준비하고 있습니다.[/b] 자금과 개발자가 충원되야 재런칭이 가능할 것으로 생각되어 새로운 프로젝트가 성공적으로 진행될 수 있도록 꾸준한 응원 해 주시면 저희도 꼭 슈퍼피플1의 재미를 다시 한번 선사할 수 있도록 지속 소통하며 정보 공유 드리도록 하겠습니다.

앞으로의 행보를 지켜봐 주시고, 많은 응원과 격려 부탁드립니다. 감사합니다.

notes.title: An Important announcement from Vision Studio
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors,

This is Vision Studio, the development team behind World of the dead.[/b]


First and foremost, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to all of you who love and support us, Wonder People, and our previous project, Super People. We want to thank you for your continued passionate interest and love, which act as powerful catalysts for us to keep moving forward.

We fully recognise that many in the community still hold strong affection and fond memories of Super People. We believe that all the reviews- whether positive or negative- and the excitement around World of the dead wouldn’t have been possible if the community’s fiery passion for Super People had already faded. We continue to feel a sense of guilt for letting our fans down by ultimately terminating the service of Super People.

To be truthful, Super People was a large-scale project, with a development investment of approximately 60 Million USD and around 200 developers. Despite our initial passion, we faced numerous unforeseen challenges early on, including issues with cheating and a flawed business model. These problems left us unable to cover server costs and various operational expenses, and we even struggled to pay our staff on time.

In the end, only a small group of five passionate staff members remained, working tirelessly to maintain in-game balance while keeping the service running at the same time. Unfortunately, as the playerbase gradually declined and matchmaking became unfeasible, our team had no choice but to shut down the project.

Even in such dire circumstances, we could not let go of Super People, therefore we started working on World of the dead, a new variation mode stemming from the original Super People project, in hopes of reviving our beloved project.

Fortunately, after series of internal tests of the prototype version of World of the dead, the positive feedback spread quickly, and over time, more and more developers returned to join the team. As a result, what was once a small group of five has now grown to a team of 30, and the number is still growing.

We acknowledge that many of our fans have suggested that it would be wise for us to just ditch the new project and bring Super People 1 back to life. While we wanted to listen to these valuable voices, we were very hesitant to reopen Super People 1 due to the financial struggles we faced during that time- the traumatising time when we failed to pay our staff on time, and struggled to cover operational costs.

To us, World of the dead is more than just a new project built on Super People’s IP and resources; it is a spin-off rooted in the same Super People universe, designed to offer a short but intense shooting experience.

In the game’s lore, much like the fall of Super People project, the story begins with a catastrophic experiment on Orb Island where a particle accelerator opens a portal to another dimension. Demons, zombies, and beasts invade the island, leading to the destruction of the world. Survivors who have lost their special powers must now find means to procure weapons to defend themselves, grow stronger, and defeat the EndBringer to rejuvenate the world. This lore mirrors our past journey-- just five of us remaining after the fall of Super People, still dreaming of its comeback.

Our entire team is working hard to ensure the success of World of the dead, and our core goal is to provide an opportunity for our fans to once again experience the fun side of Super People.

[b]We would like to hereby make a bold announcement that we are aiming to launch Super People 1 in the first half of next year.[/b] However, this can only be achieved with the necessary additional funding and additional developers. Your ongoing support for World of the dead would be very crucial in making this happen, and we promise to keep communicating and sharing updates with our fans on our progress towards bringing Super People 1 back to life.

Please continue to follow us on this journey, and we greatly appreciate your support and encouragement.

Thank you.

notes.title: Welcome to World of the dead!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215824/f9f281d1496a347b19d051d1bcbce8819966fe40.png[/img]
[h2]Greetings, Survivors.[/h2]

Welcome to the official Steam Community Hub page of World of the dead! We admire your courage as you are about to embark on this hellish journey through a world where fear and greed reign.

Allow us to introduce our project, World of the dead. World of the dead is a post-apocalyptic horror PvPvE extraction shooter that blends survival elements with high-stakes combat. 

In a world devastated by mankind's greed and demonic invasion, you will explore desolate suburbs and dark, dangerous tunnels in search of vital supplies and weapons, all while fighting your way through hordes of zombies and otherworldly creatures. 

Gaining the upper hand in survival often means raiding and looting other survivors, as only the strongest will endure in a place where light cannot reach.

The game’s combat system features a wide range of modern weaponry and customisable armour modifications. Each weapon class offers advantages or disadvantages against different types of enemies, so choosing the right loadout is essential. Balance offensive and defensive strategies, and make every decision count in the battle for survival.

[b]We are working hard to include a demo version of our game in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, which runs from October 14th to October 21st.[/b] If everything goes well, we will certainly invite you to step into this unforgiving world, test your skills, and experience the true horrors.

Once again, welcome to World of the dead. Only the clever and the brave will survive in this brutal landscape!
